technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term trend support (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) but weak near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, negative MACD, price below key MAs) and no active strategy triggers—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 14 days presents elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is neutral with only small trades 97+ days old; market fear (30 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but lack of recent news data and bearish AAII sentiment (41.4%) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (401.76), flat yield curve, imminent NFP event, and earnings in 14 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish alignment and contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis) provide structural support for reversal, with price near support level 293.997.
debate.key_bear_argument: Confluence of crisis VIX, imminent earnings (14 days), negative near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, MACD negative, price below all key MAs), zero strategy triggers, and weak fundamental/sentiment signals create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish structure and price at support (293.997) offer structural reversal setup; contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis) presents asymmetric risk-reward for patient entry.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (401.76), earnings in 14 days, and negative near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, MACD negative, price below all key MAs) create unacceptable macro and event risk; zero strategy triggers indicate insufficient confluence.

decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 3 other IT holdings in 31-position portfolio create sector concentration; earnings proximity and high volatility warrant deferral until post-earnings clarity or stronger technical confluence.
